source_title: Security and Privacy Controls for Information Systems and Organizations SP 800-53 Revision 5.1
claim_supported: Supports access enforcement least privilege separation of duties audit accountability and controls for processes acting on behalf of users.
limitations: Federal control catalog requiring organizational selection and tailoring; not an agent architecture standard implementation proof or certification.

claim_supported: Defines a protocol mechanism for fine-grained authorization details including types actions locations datatypes identifiers and refusal of invalid authorization details.
limitations: OAuth protocol specification rather than a complete business-authorization policy; its examples do not authorize facility actions and implementation-specific semantics remain outside the specification.

claim_supported: Defines subject and actor token concepts for delegation and impersonation and an actor claim that can represent the current actor and delegation chain.
limitations: Protocol mechanism only; token exchange does not by itself revoke input tokens propagate revocation prove human approval or establish that an actor may perform a facility action.

claim_supported: Defines general provenance concepts for entities activities agents attribution association delegation generation use derivation and invalidation.
limitations: Provenance vocabulary only; does not prove source truth authority policy compliance action success reconciliation or appropriate human oversight.

claim_supported: Supports governing identifying protecting detecting responding and recovering through outcome-oriented cybersecurity risk management including incident response and recovery planning.
limitations: Voluntary cross-sector framework; does not prescribe this handback method guarantee recovery establish incident status or certify an agent workflow.
